## Changes
- Quick cameras: Flyby, Chase, Orbit, Onboard and Ground tracker with one click, on the pad, in the air and in orbit.
- Takes with a timeline: a take is a list of shots. Fly the free camera to a good place and press Add key here, or add a shot from a preset.
- A shot can start at a time, after the shot before, or on a flight event such as lift-off, a stage or a docking.
- Slow motion and speed keys: a take can change the sim speed on its timeline.
- Flight recording and replay (experimental, off until you turn it on in Settings): record a flight, then play a take on it afterward and edit its shots while you watch.
- Render to pictures: save every frame as a numbered picture, for a live take and for a replay.
- Event log: each run writes the time of every event, with a script that turns it into markers for a video editor.
- All of the code, the tests and the documentation of this mod were written by an AI model, which I directed and tested in the game. Please open an issue or message me on the KSA Discord if you find a problem.

## Compatibility
Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.10.5801**.

## Installation
Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\CineCam\`.
Requires [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap).

listing.name: CineCam
listing.abstract: A camera mod for Kitten Space Agency: one-click quick cameras, takes with a timeline, and a flight replay to direct the cameras afterward.
listing.description:
![A chase camera follows a rocket above the clouds](ksa-image:chase-ascent)

A camera mod for Kitten Space Agency. Pick a camera with one click, or build a take with a timeline and film your flight.

This mod is written against the [StarMap loader](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap). It is tested against KSA build 2026.11.10.5801 only.

## Features

- **Quick cameras.** Flyby, Chase, Orbit, Onboard and Ground tracker. One click, no setup, on the pad, in the air and in orbit.
- **Takes with a timeline.** A take is a list of shots. Fly the free camera to a good place and press Add key here, or add a shot from a preset. No numbers to type.
- **Events.** A shot can start at a time, after the shot before, or on a flight event such as lift-off, a stage or a docking.
- **Slow motion and speed keys.** A button sets the sim speed, and a take can change the sim speed on a timeline.
- **Flight recording and replay (experimental).** Record a flight, then play a take on it afterward and edit its shots while you watch.
- **Render to pictures.** Save every frame as a numbered picture, so the video has the exact speed at any render speed. This works for a live take and for a replay.
- **Event log.** Each run writes the time of every event, with a tool that turns it into markers for a video editor.

![The Editor page with a take and the timeline dock](ksa-image:editor-timeline)

## Installation

1. Install [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap) 0.5.3 or later.
2. Extract the mod into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\CineCam\`.
3. The game finds new mods and asks to enable them. You can also add this to `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\manifest.toml`:

```toml
[[mods]]
id = "CineCam"
enabled = true
```

## Quick start

1. Load a flight and select a vehicle. The mod does not work in the vehicle editor.
2. Open the window with the **CineCam** item of the **Mods** menu, or press **Insert**.
3. On the **Quick** page, click a camera. Click **Stop** to give the camera back.
4. To make a take, open the **Editor** page and press **New take**. Fly the free camera to a good place, press **Add key here** and pick a shot type. Press **Save**.
5. Press **Start take** (or **Pause** on the keyboard) to run it. Press the key again to stop it.
6. To direct a flight afterward, turn on **Replay of recorded flights** under **Experimental** in Settings. On the Editor page choose **Record and replay**, press **Record flight**, fly, press **Stop recording**, select the recording and press **Open replay**.

![A replay shot of the launch: the rocket lifts off from the pad with its engines burning, seen from the ground](ksa-image:replay-shot)

The repository has a player guide, a flight replay and render guide, and a shot file reference in its `docs` folder.

## Known limits

- The flight replay is experimental. It draws the recorded vehicles through patches of the game renderer, so a game update can break it. It is off until you turn it on.
- A replay does not show audio, crew, kittens on EVA, parachute canopies, dents, plume trails, smoke and particles. For a launch video with engine sound, use a live take.
- A replay opens only on the game build of the recording, in the same star system, with its parts installed.
- A recording holds 20 minutes of game time at 1x speed and follows the controlled vehicle and a limited number of other vehicles.
- The mod patches game methods that are not a public modding interface, so a game update can break a feature until the mod is updated. It writes a warning in the log on another build.
- The import of the marker file into DaVinci Resolve has not been tested.

## How this mod was made

I did not write a single line of this mod myself. All of the code, the tests and the documentation were written by an AI model (Claude), which I directed and tested in the game. I do not know the codebase in detail. It has worked really well for me so far and I find it useful, so I am publishing it.

If you find a problem, please open an issue on GitHub or message me on the KSA Discord (Maxi).

## Dependencies

- [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap): mod loader, required at runtime. Version 0.5.3 or later.

## Build dependencies

Required only to build the mod from source.

- [StarMap.API](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap) from NuGet, tested version 0.5.2.
- [Lib.Harmony](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Lib.Harmony) from NuGet, tested version 2.4.2.
